title: Ordinary pro-etale scalar-balancing normalization data
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of arbitrary commutative rings. Use the small pro-etale constant-ring module categories and identified-coefficient pullbacks $f_A^*,f_B^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the actual constant-ring maps $\varphi_Z:A_Z\to B_Z$ of [def-sp-proetale-constant-coefficient-ring-map], and the canonical constant-section comparisons $c_R:f^{-1}R_Y\simeq R_X$ of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. For $Z=X,Y$, let $r_Z$ be scalar restriction, $C_Z=r_ZB_Z$, $F_Z(M)=M\otimes_{A_Z}C_Z$, $E_Z$ ordinary extension of scalars, and $e_Z:r_ZE_Z\simeq F_Z$ the pure-tensor-normalized identification of [def-sp-proetale-scalar-mate-identifications].

Define $\beta:r_Xf_B^*\simeq f_A^*r_Y$ as the inverse of the ordinary restriction/pullback mate defined in [def-weil-pbc-ring-restriction-pullback-comparison], specialized to these actual coefficient maps and $c_A,c_B$; its invertibility is the ordinary comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. For any supplied natural isomorphism $t:f_A^*F_Y\simeq F_Xf_A^*$ and any $A_Y$-module sheaf $M$, define the underlying $A_X$-linear map
$$b_{t,M}:r_Xf_B^*E_YM\longrightarrow r_XE_Xf_A^*M$$
by the composite $\beta_{E_YM}$, $f_A^*(e_{Y,M})$, $t_M$, and $e_{X,f_A^*M}^{-1}$, in that order. This definition does not assert $B_X$-linearity.

Define $\operatorname{IsScalarBalancing}(\varphi,f,t)$ to mean the following equation for every $M$, every $U\in Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, every $x\in M(U)$ and every $s\in B_Y(U)$. On $X\times_Y U$, $t_M$ carries the inverse-image adjunction unit applied to the sheafification image of the presheaf pure tensor $x\otimes s$ to the sheafification image of $\eta_M(x)\otimes c_B(f^{-1}s)$, where $\eta$ is the canonical identified-coefficient inverse-image unit. All sections here are arbitrary local sections; no existence of a normalized $t$, scalar linearity theorem, finiteness, flatness, boundedness or geometric restriction is included in these definitions.

      proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f ⋙ scalarMateOrdinaryTensor φ X) : Prop
